plainTranslation: Deep, transformative love that flows without the power struggle. Intimacy, honesty, and real change come more easily. Failure mode: underestimating how strong the bond is and being careless with it. Use the depth well; it's powerful even when it's smooth.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
